main_text.p: domi suæ docere capita Catechetica & formulas precum Deut. 4. v. 40. c. 6. v. 2. 2. Tim. 3. v. 15. tempestiue iplos mittere in scholam. Hebr. 6. v.1. ducere ipsos ad conciones sacras. Deut. 31. verf. 12. Ioel. 2. v. 16. Matth. 21. v. 15. 16. Luc. 2. 5 v. 46. domi ab illis exigere conciones, & omninò fungi vicem præceptorum domesticorum. Deut. 6. v. 7. Psal. 34. v. 12. Prou. 4. v. 1. 2. 3. & seqq. item potestate patriâ & disciplinâ erga illos rectè uti Prou. 13. v. 24. c. 19. v. 18. c. 23. v. 13. 14. c. 29. verf. 15. Hebr. 12. v. 5. 6. Eccles. 30. v. 1. exploratis ipsorum ingeniis, ipsos ad certum vitæ genus dirigere. 10Prou. 20. v. 11. colligere ipsis thesauros, quantum possunt illæsâ conscientiâ. Prou. 19. ver. 14. 2. Cor. 12. v. 14. ita nempe, ut simul, & inprimis, relinquant ipsis thesauros in cœlo Matth. 6. verf. 20. Prou. 8. v. 10. 11. Officium proprium est patris, vel matris. Proprium patris officium est tum defensionis, quâ liberos suos pro viribus, quibus præ matre pollet, ab omnibus malis tutos præstat Matth. 2. v. 14. tum authoritatis, quâ ipsos in officio continet Eph. 6. v. 4. tum solicitudinis, quâ ipsos elocat, & post mortem quoque ipsis prospicit de alimentis, tutoribus &c. Gen. 24. & 49. 2. Paral. 21. v. 3. Iohan. 19. v. 26. 27. 1. Maccab. 2. v. 64. & seqq. Proprium matris officium est tum lactationis, tum familiaritatis. Illud in eo consistit, ut mater proprio lacte nutriat infantulum, si per valetudinem possit. Gen. 21. verf. 7. 1. Sam. 1. 15v. 23. Hoc situm est in materna conuersatione & institutione. Gen. 24. v. 15. 16. c. 29. v. 6. Familiaritas ista temperanda est gravitate, ne degeneret in indulgentiam. Esa. 3. v. 17. Eccles. 42. v. 12.

XXI. Officium liberorum erga parentes est obedientiæ, obseruantiæ, & gratitudinis. In his enim posita est philostorgia liberorum erga parentes. Obedientia est, quâ liberi etiam ad nutus parentum, & interna animi sensa vel coniecturis cognita, prômtè actiones suas ex animo instituunt. Prou. 6. v. 20. c. 15. v. 5. Eph. 6. 25v. 1. 2. 3. Col. 3. v. 20. Sed cauto hîc est opus, ne ista obedientia sit cœca & nimia, putâ impia & inhonesta. Matt. 10. v. 37.

page.notes: Printed line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 are rendered as left-margin notes; the number 30 at the start of the last paragraph is printed as "3o" and read as 30, and the number 35 beside "v. 1. 2. 3." was read as 25 by mistake in the markup above and should be checked. The bottom-right "v.37." is the continuation of "Matt.10." and is kept with it. Left edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are excluded. Abbreviations and spelling (Esa., Eccles., Maccab.) are kept as printed.
